name: IntegrateIT UniFi Protect
notes: Surfaces UniFi Protect camera activity to Control4 programming over the official Protect Integration API (local HTTPS, X-API-KEY): camera inventory and per-camera reachability from GET /v1/cameras, plus motion, smart-detection (person / vehicle / package / animal), and doorbell-ring events read by polling the console's event feed. Events only — no video, no streams. LAN-only destination safeguard, the API key never logged, and MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
